response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering expertise and 20+ years of technical experience meeting the educational requirement, he fundamentally lacks the specialized knowledge required for this role. His background is entirely in software development, services architecture, and web technologies, with no demonstrated experience in SoC design, IP modeling, GPU architecture, or deep learning workload optimization. The recent AI infrastructure work at re:cinq involves agent frameworks and developer tooling, not hardware performance analysis or accelerator optimization. The gap between a generalist software architect and a principal hardware performance specialist is too significant to bridge without extensive additional training.
strengths: 20 years of professional software development experience with proven ability to master complex technical systems
Demonstrated performance optimization expertise including low-latency systems and microservices handling millions of requests at scale
Currently working on AI infrastructure systems (MCP, agentic workflows) showing exposure to emerging AI technology landscape
concerns: Zero documented experience with SoC design, IP modeling, or hardware architecture fundamentals essential for the role
No background in deep learning workload optimization, GPU architecture, or AI accelerator performance analysis
Career entirely focused on software engineering rather than hardware-software co-design or systems architecture at the silicon level
